summary.name: Kaleidoscopic Animation. Category: Motion Design and Cinematography. Label normalized from an explicit kaleidoscope effect.
summary.visualIdentity: A pattern built around a fixed center and a deliberate number of mirrored sectors, with artwork replicated through rotated and mirrored copies. Rotation speed, density and palette stay coherent, and shape changes preserve symmetry. Medium, materials and background are unspecified.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit good fits: psychedelic and demoscene imagery, infinite zoom and kaleidoscopic transitions, and surreal or abstract spatial passages. Suggested pairings add music visuals, VJ loops, and gala openers or luxury event loops. Works alone for ambient visuals.
summary.limitations: Keep text out of repeated sectors. Avoid center jumps and rapid flicker. Dense text during travel is unsuitable, and stable orientation or reduced motion needs restrained motion. Exact subject, audience, duration, aspect ratio, resolution and frame rate are unspecified.
summary.palette: Background policy is scene-dependent, so the dark plum swatch #201D32 is illustrative, not a required canvas. Suggested tokens are foreground #F4E8D4, violet #9E7FB9, teal #5EA7A0 and amber #D8A169, in organized mirrored fields. Gradients are disabled. This is an unapproved suggestion; task-provided exact colors override it. Foreground on background is 13.513, and accent-on-background pairs range from 4.824 to 7.186. Recheck composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Motion is rotation and shape evolution around the fixed center, driven from composition time while preserving symmetry and avoiding flicker. Smooth coherent movement is preferred, with deliberate cuts and reading holds allowed. Scroll or pointer input applies only to optional interactive delivery and must not drive video. Optional references: motion-039 radial burst, motion-002 vortex passage and motion-012 chapter handoff, each used only when scene assets support its defining action.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified and not mandatory; silence is valid. Music timing can drive sector-count changes on section boundaries and rotation accents on downbeats, but only after inspecting real audio. No genre, tempo, voice or sound-effect requirement is stated. Do not claim beat synchronization without measured audio analysis.
summary.assetRequirements: No mandatory uploads are specified. Artwork must be supplied or generated procedurally to build the mirrored sectors. Exact copy, subject and brand marks are unspecified; motion-039 requires an inspected approved mark and forbids invented marks. Load fonts and assets before rendering. A decorative motif source is optional.
summary.combinations: Style-105 supplies beat-map timing for rotation and sector changes, with pause control and flicker limits in HTML. Style-006 supplies Art Deco motifs inside sectors in gold accent, with a WebGL background and static fallback; avoid indiscriminate gold sparkle. Motion-002, motion-012 and motion-039 are optional references. Choosing none is valid.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Canvas 2D, WebGL and GLSL for sector replication. Motion engine: GLSL, driving phase and rotation from a shared center and fixed symmetry parameters. Render pipeline: HyperFrames by default, with a paused seekable GSAP timeline registered in window.__timelines. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and the reason must be recorded. Verify forward, backward and direct seeks, plus opening, action, transition, closing frames and loop seams. Deliver the video, source, contact sheet, parameters and render instructions.
